It ends the current handler with a diagnosable runtime error instead of silently evaluating to nothing; the host remains reusable for subsequently enqueued messages, as for any other runtime error.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesProgramProfiler
files.Summary: Instruction-boundary callbacks for one loaded instance. Callbacks must not throw, pump a host, or modify execution. No callback is made while the host waits between slices.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesPublishSink

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesRuntimeObserver
files.Summary: Observes synchronous host behavior without participating in dispatch. Implementations must not throw and must not recursively pump the observed host. Every queued emit, processed publish, received message, delayed send and initialization message carries a host-local send ID: it starts at 1, increases by one per such send and is reported by every callback about that send, from emit, publish or scheduling to each dispatch or discard. 0 reports a send without an ID. Every callback has an empty default implementation, so an observer implements only the callbacks it needs.
